budgets.external_deadline: Independent2700second process-group deadline required around official CLI; internal SIGALRM andRLIMIT_CPU also active
budgets.failed_attempts: Charge same-seed cumulative wall/CPU; interrupted unknownwork charged conservatively before retry

fit_count: 2endpoints*5outer*(2learners*3inner+2outerlearners);10extraouterfits versus70selected-only fits belong to whichever learner inner selection did not choose

folds.support: Both classes in every train/assessment population, at least two positive and two negative families in every assessment population, both seeds before any fit
folds.unsupported: Stop before fits; separate prospective3outer/3inner design permitted on same groups; no seed search or outcome repair

hypothesis: A frozen nonlinear learner selected only inside grouped inner folds can improve TDI classification over a useful logistic fallback. Produce first actual TDI file only after both-seed qualification.
native_defaults: Remaining native optimizer defaults are fixed by pinned builds and recorded from fitted estimators; no automatic balancing, eval_set or early stopping
numeric_failures: Convergence warnings or invalid probabilities fail; no outcome-driven tolerance/iteration repair

population.labels: Published0/1 with raw tokens and missing mask, never derived from other assay columns

production_if_qualified.scope: Full-development3foldOOF thresholds/model choice then two final classifiers; same frozen policy, saved/reloaded models and actual750blinded predictions

repeat2_stop_rule: Stop if seed1 integrity fails or neither logistic usefulness nor selected usefulness+superiority could qualify; otherwise repeat2 unchanged. No recommendation without both seeds.
retention: All80estimators, original probabilities, inner threshold/model choices, exact IDs/features/labels/source/runtime receipts; fresh reload probability parity atol1e-12 rtol0

scoring.primary: mean of1000name-sorted label-masked endpoint MCC bootstrap means, macroaveraged

selection: Choose inner-selected procedure only if both-seed usefulness and superiority gates pass; otherwise useful both-seed logistic. CatBoost standalone diagnostic not an outcome-selected rescue. None useful means no submission.

threshold.candidates: sorted unique({0.5} union inner OOF probabilities)
threshold.ties: closest0.5 then lower threshold, exact score ties
threshold.unsupported_learner: selection score negative infinity;0.5 diagnostic/fallback threshold only; both learners unsupported fails seed
threshold.valid_partition: both predicted classes in labeled inner OOF
